Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I've been looking at IT and software services companies in Bangladesh, and Hitech Inter Studio caught my attention. In the IT services space, the biggest leak is usually in lead qualification — enquiries come through your website form and phone, but there's no automated way to filter serious buyers from tyre-kickers before your senior developers spend time on calls.

Here's the pattern I see: a potential client fills out your contact form asking about 'mobile app development' or 'custom software'. Right now, someone on your team reads that form, manually replies, schedules a call, and then discovers the client's budget is ৳50,000 for a project that should cost ৳5,00,000. That's an hour of senior time wasted on an unqualified lead.

I built an AI lead qualification agent that handles incoming enquiries 24/7 — it asks about project scope, budget range, timeline, and technical requirements, then scores the lead and books a discovery call only for qualified prospects. Your senior team spends time closing deals, not filtering enquiries.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
